title: Nested if se priority check
solution:
function priority(score, isUrgent) {
  if (score >= 90) return "Critical"
  if (score >= 70 && isUrgent) return "High"
  if (score >= 70) return "Medium"
  if (isUrgent) return "Low-Urgent"
  return "Low"
}
hints: Score aur urgency dono alag check hote hain
